$comment: npm audit advisories CI accepts in the release tooling until each entry expires; checked by scripts/security/check_npm_audit.py in .github/workflows/security-npm.yaml. Add an entry only for an advisory with no usable fix whose code the release never runs, and remove it once a fix ships: the check warns on an entry no longer reported, and fails on one past its expiry. "expires": null means no expiry; the entry then lasts until it is removed, with a warning once its advisory is no longer reported. "dev_only" does not apply here: every package in this project is a production dependency of the tool.

allowlist.reason: glob is bundled inside npm, which only @semantic-release/npm pulls in. .releaserc.json does not load that plugin, so the code never runs, and no npm release yet bundles a fixed glob (>= 14.0.2).

minimatch is bundled inside npm, which only @semantic-release/npm pulls in. .releaserc.json does not load that plugin, so the code never runs, and no npm release yet bundles a fixed minimatch (>= 11.0.1).
